description: The easiest way to start making content. Give a short brief and one entry per output you need; intendedUse is optional. You write each image or video prompt yourself: look at the reference image, describe the product (type, colour, material, details that must not change) and the shot (for example hero, lifestyle, detail, or a short motion plan), following the model prompt guide. If a prompt is missing, Berrys returns prompts_required with the reference preview and the guide instead of a quote; write the prompts and call again. Berrys then returns an exact, free credit quote; it does not create nodes or spend credits. For a new creative task, create a fresh project first with playground_project_create; for a follow-up, reuse its projectId. Import any uploaded or linked image to that project first and pass its image node ID as a reference. Audio needs the exact spoken words or lyrics. Review the returned prompts, references, defaults and price with the user; the returned mediaGenerateRequest is the exact input for playground_media_generate with quoteId and a new idempotencyKey when they want to proceed.

brandId.description: An explicitly selected brand owned by the connected account. Its saved rules are included in the quoted image/video prompts.

brief.description: User’s creative goal, product context and requirements for the deliverables.

aspectRatio.description: Output width-to-height ratio supported by the selected model, such as 1:1 or 9:16.

count.description: Number of outputs requested for this deliverable.

duration.description: Requested video duration in seconds, supported by the selected model.

kind.description: Media type to create or import, selected from the supported values.

modelId.description: Canonical model ID returned by model discovery or resolution; preserve the user’s selected model.

prompt.description: Complete creative instructions for this output; describe the subject, composition and requested result. The creative prompt for this output, written from what you see in the reference image and following the model's prompt guide. Required for images and video: without it Berrys returns prompts_required with the reference preview and guide. For audio: the exact words or lyrics.

referenceNodeIds.description: Existing canvas image or media node IDs to use as visual references for this output.

style.description: Style direction for the generated audio, such as tone, delivery or musical mood.

title.description: Human-readable label to display for this item in Playground.

voice.description: Voice identifier supported by the selected speech model.

intendedUse.description: Where the content will be used, for example a product listing, social post or ad. Omit when the user has no specific placement.

locale.description: Language or locale to use for the deliverable text, such as en or id-ID. Language tag such as en, id-ID, th-TH, or vi-VN.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.
